projection.enumEncoding: JSON string enums are encoded as OneNet integer enums; generated wire mapping is authoritative for integer-to-symbol conversion.
projection.fixedFieldEncoding: commandType/eventType/deliveryClass and target type remain explicit enum parameters and must equal the function identifier registry.
projection.nullableEncoding: Every nullable field is encoded as <field>Present plus a typed placeholder value; adapters reconstruct JSON null before payload digest validation.
projection.objectEncoding: Envelope and payload wrapper are projected losslessly; when a service would exceed OneNet's 20 top-level input limit, primitive parameters are grouped into one-level scalarFields/scalarFieldsN structs of at most 20 members each. Nested business objects use one-level struct; arrays of objects use array-of-struct.
projection.semanticValidation: OneNet validates primitive shapes; edge and backend must still validate the authoritative Draft 2020-12 schema and semanticChecksBeyondJsonSchema.
